title: What Counts as Chemistry Evidence?
purpose: Introduce scientific inquiry, investigation types, variables, measurement, and percent error.
labDataRequirement: Use written investigation scenarios only. Students identify variables and calculate percent error; no chemicals are handled.
safetyNotes: Do not perform the checkpoint investigation or handle chemicals. Use only the written scenario and provided data.
simulationReview: The Savvas Scientific Inquiry and Measurement reading and PDF worksheet provide the lesson instruction and guided practice. No separate simulation is required.
assessmentStimulusNeeded: Use an investigation scenario with variables and measurement data.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: No simulation is required for this introductory scientific inquiry and measurement lesson.

simulationReviewImplementation: Not applicable. Students use the direct Savvas reading and PDF worksheet.
